_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Daman and Diu and Dadra and Nagar Haveli. 1. The applicant should establish a small-scale dairy unit with 10 milch cows. 1. The applicant should procure indigenous Gir breed cows only. 1. The applicant should avail a bank loan for implementation of the project. 1. The applicant should utilise the subsidy strictly for approved components. 1. The applicant should maintain records as per the General Financial Rules, 1963. > **Preference / Reservation / Relaxation:** The applicant belonging to the Scheduled Caste or the Scheduled Tribe category is eligible for a higher subsidy rate under the back-ended subsidy and insurance components.
